firstPlayerRule: The player with the sharpest teeth goes first.
clarifications: Players then take turns clockwise, starting with that player.
internalEvidence: Visually checked image-only PDF pages 3-4 of the publisher-authored English rulebook hosted by Gus & Co. Page 3 names the sharpest-teeth criterion; page 4 gives clockwise play.
